changelog.change: Fifth UDMI (2026, presented ESC Munich Aug 30) supersedes the Fourth: Type 1-5 numbering replaced by primary / secondary / procedure-related categories; sex-specific troponin 99th-percentile URLs; procedure-related MI no longer uses a fixed biomarker multiple; MINOCA redefined as 'injury' (working dx). The ST-elevation ECG thresholds below are unchanged. Source: CV 'Fifth Universal Definition of MI, Audited'.
Initial entry — numeric ST-elevation thresholds by lead/sex/age.

summary: The numeric ST-elevation thresholds behind "STEMI", plus territory localization and IABP timing. Reflects the Fifth Universal Definition of MI (2026).

body.text: Fifth UDMI (2026) — what changed from the Fourth: the Type 1-5 numbering is replaced by three bedside categories — PRIMARY (acute coronary pathology, ~old Type 1), SECONDARY (supply/demand imbalance from another acute condition, ~old Type 2), and PROCEDURE-RELATED (within 30 days of a cardiac procedure; no fixed biomarker-multiple cutoff any more — injury + a clinical/ECG feature). Troponin now uses SEX-SPECIFIC 99th-percentile upper reference limits. 'MINOCA' = myocardial INJURY (working dx) with non-obstructive coronaries. The ST-elevation ECG criteria below carry forward unchanged.
ST-elevation thresholds (J-point, two contiguous leads required)

rows: New LBBB + instability / new heart failure
Treat as STEMI-equivalent regardless of ST measurements

body.text: V2-V3 get their own thresholds because normal J-point elevation is physiologically higher there and higher in men — a flat 1 mm rule would under-call STEMI in young men and over-call it in women and older patients. The elevation must be in TWO contiguous leads in every case.

items: Inferior: II, III, aVF (RCA or LCx) — add right-sided leads (V4R) for RV involvement
Posterior: reciprocal ST depression V1-V3 ± posterior leads V7-V9 (≥ 0.5 mm)

body.text: Inflate at the dicrotic notch (early diastole) to augment coronary perfusion; deflate just before systole to reduce afterload. Early/late inflation and early/late deflation each produce a characteristic waveform abnormality — a troubleshooting table pairing waveform to timing error belongs here (media TBD).
